_note: NRC-6 sample responses for POST /v1/marketing/jobs/{job_id}/cancel. All data is synthetic. Validated against the API schemas by tests/test_contract.py.

cancel_requested.request: POST /v1/marketing/jobs/2e9c4a6b-5d17-4b83-9a02-7f1d3c5e8b64/cancel  (202; repeating it returns the same body)

cancelled.request: GET /v1/marketing/jobs/2e9c4a6b-5d17-4b83-9a02-7f1d3c5e8b64 after the worker finished the cancel (200). failure_code says what the cancel cost: CANCELLED (nothing billed), CANCELLED_AFTER_COMPLETION (the provider had already produced and billed an image, which was not kept) or CANCELLED_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN (credits held until reviewed). It is not an error to show as a failure.

body.failure_message: The job was cancelled after the provider produced and billed an image; the image was not kept.

not_cancellable.request: POST /v1/marketing/jobs/{job_id}/cancel  (409, the job already SUCCEEDED or FAILED)
